entities.name: Aegidius Gelenius
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aegidius Gelenius was a German clergyman and historian who worked as historiographer to the Archbishop-Elector of Cologne, Ferdinand of Bavaria. He had at his disposal some earlier sources that are not in existence today, including a life of Herman of Scheda.
